items.quote: Rest energy is the reflection of C²M: the energy a Movement has by existing in the Current, even when it isn't changing in Vibration. Kinetic energy is the reflection of a Movement changing its Vibration, which is where Frequency and Appreciation live.
items.note: B (E = C²M) is the rest-energy case, the zero-momentum term. A is the fuller relation that adds the momentum and kinetic contribution. Both hold at once. The passage doesn't write out the squared sum, but it separates rest energy from the energy of a changing Vibration, which is the split A needs.
